status.summary: The revised restructuring report for Guangdong HEC Technology's acquisition of Chindata's China business, published on cninfo on 23 September 2026 (signed September 2026), lists Sangyuan phases 1 and 2 (环首都·桑园云计算产业基地建设项目 一期 and 二期; 河北秦淮数据有限公司 and 怀来斯达智数据科技有限公司) at Huangying village, Sangyuan town, as built with real-estate title certificates (phase 1 in 2021; the phase 2 power centre, 2# and 3# machine-room buildings and pump room in 2024) and completed environmental acceptance, drops phase 2 from construction in progress during 2025, and states that, as of its signing date, the 110 kV substation buildings used for phase 2 are in normal and sustainable use. The valuer's reply in the same filing says the built projects can all be used normally, while noting that part of phase 2's energy-saving acceptance is still pending. This supports current operation of the two phases; phase 3 (built per the report but unfinished per the valuer) is excluded, and phase-level capacity, load, customers and service-start dates are not taken from the filing.

locator.precision: Area centroid of the quadrilateral formed by the four corner control points printed on the official Sangyuan phase 2 site plan (14 March 2024) around the 2# and 3# machine-room buildings, converted from CGCS2000 3-degree Gauss-Kruger zone 39. The quadrilateral is about 105 m east-west by 172 m north-south (18,020 m2) inside the 31,386.72 m2 phase 2 parcel; the point falls on the machine-room roof block. It locates the Sangyuan campus through its phase 2 machine-room block, not a red-line parcel centroid, building corner, entrance, the 110 kV substation or a campus boundary. Phase 1, across the east-west road to the south-east, and the adjoining phase 3 to the east are not separately located.
locator.identity_review: The restructuring report places Sangyuan phase 1 (河北秦淮数据有限公司, 33,333.33 m2) and phase 2 (怀来斯达智数据科技有限公司, 31,386.72 m2) at 黄营村, Sangyuan town, Huailai. The Huailai planning publicities of 17 March 2023 and 14 March 2024 name the same phase 2 project, builder, village and 31,386.72 m2 of land, and the 2024 site plan, which gives the point, shows the titled 1# power centre, 2# and 3# machine-room buildings and 4# pump room, the substation's 5# and 6# buildings, and the phase 3 block on the east. The 2023 land-use analysis sheet places the built phase 1 land (一期建设用地(已建成)) south-east of phase 2 across the east-west road, west of S241, and the 12 May 2026 phase 3 planning verification gives the builder's address as the phase 1 base. The four printed corners reproduce the sheet's 104.70 m south-road dimension and a fifth printed point lies exactly on the west side; the approved phase 3 sheet's west red line passes within 0.01 m of the two eastern points, so both sheets share one grid. The sheet names no datum; read as CGCS2000, as the 2026 Huailai Jingxi sheet states for the same grid, the converted quadrilateral frames a large roof block in a 23 October 2026 Sentinel-2 L2A window, with the phase 3 block east of it and a further large block across the road to the south-east where the 2023 sheet places phase 1 (imagery used only as a check). This reopens the Sangyuan part of the q3-china-operators-p3 and cn-hebei-tianjin-beijing-p5 holds, which lacked a locator. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-11-07-china-operators-p13-chindata-sangyuan-geometry-facts.json.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The site plan names neither its datum nor the survey accuracy of its printed points; the CGCS2000 reading is supported by the 10 m Sentinel-2 check, and the conversion adds no material error. The point is a derived centroid of design control points whose corners lie up to 101 m away, and the phases 1-2 campus extends to phase 1's buildings roughly 150-460 m south-east of the point. Decimal places are computation precision, not accuracy.
